title: Illicit Major
also_known_as: illicit process of the major term
description: Any form of a *categorical syllogism* in which the major term is distributed in the conclusion, but not in the major premise.
logical_form:
All A are B.

No C are A.

Therefore, no C are B.

examples.example:
All hotdogs are fast food.

No hamburgers are hotdogs.

Therefore, no hamburgers are fast food.
examples.explanation: In our example, the major term is “fast food”, because it is the term that appears in the major premise (first premise) as the predicate and in the conclusion.  As such, in this position, it is “undistributed”.

examples.example:
All Jim Carrey movies are hilarious.

No horror movies are Jim Carrey movies.

Therefore, no horror movies are hilarious.
examples.explanation: In our example, the major term is “hilarious”, because it is the term that appears in the major premise (first premise) as the predicate and in the conclusion.  As such, in this position, it is “undistributed”.

tips: If you are not sure if a syllogism is fallacious or not, keep substituting the items in the syllogism for other items. If a syllogism is consistent with the form but clearly doesn’t make sense, you will know that it is fallacious.
references: Neil, S. (1853). *The Art of Reasoning: A Popular Exposition of the Principles of Logic*. Walton & Maberly.
description_et: *Kategoorilise süllogismi* mis tahes vorm, mille puhul põhitermin on jaotatud järelduses, kuid mitte peamises eelduses.
logical_form_et:
Kõik A on B.

Ükski C pole A.

Seetõttu ükski C pole B.
tips_et: Kui te pole kindel, kas süllogism on ekslik või mitte, asendage süllogismis olevad elemendid teiste üksustega. Kui süllogism on vormiga kooskõlas, kuid sellel pole selgelt mõtet, teate, et see on ekslik.

examples_et.example:
Kõik hotdogid on kiirtoit.

Ükski hamburger pole hotdog.

Seetõttu pole ükski hamburger kiirtoit.
examples_et.explanation: Meie näites on põhitermin "kiirtoit", sest see on termin, mis esineb peamise eeldusena (esimeses eelduses) predikaadina ja järelduses.  Sellisena on see selles positsioonis "jaotamata".
